spec.title: RL state timeline
spec.description: Slime state intervals for reference/actor log-prob, actor/critic updates, and default rollout-client generation calls. sglang_generate measures the client-observed HTTP call, including network and Router overhead; it is not pure engine execution time or a serving-replica interval.

spec.title: Training loss
spec.description: Slime training loss for the selected project and experiment.

spec.title: Gradient norm
spec.description: Slime optimizer gradient norm, separated from loss and learning rate.

spec.title: Learning rate
spec.description: Slime optimizer learning rate for parameter group 0.

spec.title: Response length
spec.description: Mean generated response length reported by Slime.

spec.title: Reward
spec.description: Rollout reward reported by the selected Slime path when available.

spec.title: Truncated ratio
spec.description: Fraction of rollout samples truncated by the selected Slime path.

spec.title: Slime phase duration
spec.description: Rollout, training, and weight-update durations. All series are seconds.

spec.title: SGLang: End-to-End Request Latency
spec.description: P50, P90, P99 and mean end-to-end request latency, separated by model and replica.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, model, model_name, replica) (rate({__name__=~"sglang[:_]e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket", project=~"^${project:regex}$", experiment_name=~"^${experiment_name:regex}$", model=~"^${sglang_model:regex}$", replica=~"^${sglang_replica:regex}$"}[$__rate_interval]) >= 0))

histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le, model, model_name, replica) (rate({__name__=~"sglang[:_]e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket", project=~"^${project:regex}$", experiment_name=~"^${experiment_name:regex}$", model=~"^${sglang_model:regex}$", replica=~"^${sglang_replica:regex}$"}[$__rate_interval]) >= 0))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, model, model_name, replica) (rate({__name__=~"sglang[:_]e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket", project=~"^${project:regex}$", experiment_name=~"^${experiment_name:regex}$", model=~"^${sglang_model:regex}$", replica=~"^${sglang_replica:regex}$"}[$__rate_interval]) >= 0))

sum by (model, model_name, replica) (rate({__name__=~"sglang[:_]e2e_request_latency_seconds_sum", project=~"^${project:regex}$", experiment_name=~"^${experiment_name:regex}$", model=~"^${sglang_model:regex}$", replica=~"^${sglang_replica:regex}$"}[$__rate_interval]) >= 0) / sum by (model, model_name, replica) (rate({__name__=~"sglang[:_]e2e_request_latency_seconds_count", project=~"^${project:regex}$", experiment_name=~"^${experiment_name:regex}$", model=~"^${sglang_model:regex}$", replica=~"^${sglang_replica:regex}$"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0)

spec.title: SGLang: End-to-End Request Latency Heatmap
spec.description: End-to-end request latency bucket increases for the selected experiment, model and replica.

spec.expr: sum by (le, model, model_name, replica) (increase({__name__=~"sglang[:_]e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket", project=~"^${project:regex}$", experiment_name=~"^${experiment_name:regex}$", model=~"^${sglang_model:regex}$", replica=~"^${sglang_replica:regex}$"}[$__rate_interval]) >= 0)

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, model, model_name, replica) (rate({__name__=~"sglang[:_]time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket", project=~"^${project:regex}$", experiment_name=~"^${experiment_name:regex}$", model=~"^${sglang_model:regex}$", replica=~"^${sglang_replica:regex}$"}[$__rate_interval]) >= 0))

sum by (model, model_name, replica) (rate({__name__=~"sglang[:_]time_to_first_token_seconds_sum", project=~"^${project:regex}$", experiment_name=~"^${experiment_name:regex}$", model=~"^${sglang_model:regex}$", replica=~"^${sglang_replica:regex}$"}[$__rate_interval]) >= 0) / sum by (model, model_name, replica) (rate({__name__=~"sglang[:_]time_to_first_token_seconds_count", project=~"^${project:regex}$", experiment_name=~"^${experiment_name:regex}$", model=~"^${sglang_model:regex}$", replica=~"^${sglang_replica:regex}$"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0)
